subject: [RFC PATCH 06/57] mm/collapse: move the smallest collapse order to collapse.h

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch moves the definition of the smallest collapse order from khugepaged.c to a shared header file, collapse.h. This is done because the smallest collapse order is a property of collapse, not just khugepaged. The change prepares for the collapse engine, which will size its per-window arrays based on this floor. No functional changes are intended by this patch.
